# Step - describe_query

`describe_query` · category: [Saved queries](../../traversal/step_reference.md#saved-queries)

Sets the description of a saved query ("" or () removes it).

## Forms

```text
describe_query(arg1: string, arg2: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
{ g.define_query(#{name: "n", body: "fn n() { 1 }"}); g.describe_query("n", "One."); g.get_query("n")["description"] }   // One.
```
